description: The plot illustrates the relationship between percent sequence ratio, perplexity, and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Percent Sequence Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left is labeled “Perplexity” and has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. A solid orange line, labeled “Perplexity PPL”, begins at approximately 4.63 at 0% and decreases to approximately 4.45 at 20%, then increases to approximately 4.55 at 100%. A dashed red line, labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.”, begins at approximately 58% at 0% and decreases to approximately 48% at 20%, then increases to approximately 62% at 100%. A solid blue line, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio”, begins at approximately 42% at 0% and increases to approximately 96% at 100%.
